title: A neural architecture for imagined and overt speech motor dynamics
title_zh: 想象与言语运动动力学的神经架构
abstract: Mental imagery is a hallmark of human cognition, yet its neural mechanisms remain poorly understood. Speech imagery (the internal simulation of speech without overt articulation) has been proposed to partially share substrates with speech production, but its spatiotemporal dynamics remain controversial. Here, we leveraged high-resolution electrocorticography to investigate shared and modality-specific coding of articulatory kinematic trajectories during speech imagery and articulation. Linear modeling revealed robust articulatory kinematic trajectories encoding in frontoparietal cortex across modalities. Supramodal populations across middle premotor, subcentral and postcentral–supramarginal regions exhibited spatiotemporal stability during integrative planning. In contrast, modality-specific populations for speech imagery and articulation were somatotopically interleaved in primary sensorimotor cortex, revealing a distinct spatiotemporal organization. We further developed a generalized decoding framework that achieved high prediction accuracy for speech imagery (median 80.4%; chance 16.7%), comparable to speech articulation (78.3%). These findings uncover a somato-cognitive organization linking supramodal planning with modality-specific representations, informing imagery-based brain–computer interfaces. Using high-density electrocorticography, Zhao et al. reveal shared frontoparietal planning and modality-specific sensorimotor codes for imagined and spoken speech, enabling robust decoding of internal articulatory dynamics.
abstract_zh: 心理意象是人类认知的标志，但其神经机制仍知之甚少。言语意象（无外在发音的内部语言模拟）被提议部分共享与言语产生相同的神经基质，但其时空动力学仍备受争议。在此，我们利用高分辨率脑电图研究了言语意象和言语产生过程中运动学轨迹的共享和模式特异性编码。线性模型在额颞叶皮层揭示了跨模态中健壮的运动学轨迹编码。跨中运动前、亚中央和顶叶-旁岛叶区域的 supramodal（跨模态）人群在整合规划期间表现出时空稳定性。相比之下，言语意象和言语产生的模式特异性人群在初级感觉运动皮层中以 somatotopic（体感图）方式交错排列，揭示了不同的时空组织。我们进一步开发了一个广义解码框架，实现了言语意象（中位数 80.4%；机会 16.7%）的高预测精度，这与言语产生（78.3%）的精度相当。这些发现揭示了将 supramodal（跨模态）规划与模式特异性表征相连接的体感-认知组织，为基于意象的脑机接口提供了信息。利用高密度脑电图，Zhao 等人揭示了想象和言语 speech 共享的额颞叶规划和模式特异性感觉运动编码，实现了内部运动动力学的健壮解码。
